top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction and the Jarillo-Herrero discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states at the magic angle. The credited phenomenology has been reproduced by many independent laboratories and platforms with no conflicting experimental reports, and the open pairing mechanism does not bear on the scoped citation. It opened a previously unknown regime of electronic matter, and one prediction plus one experiment map onto three names. The cost is that Andrei's early scanning-probe work is left out and the field is only eight years old, so P003 (about two decades of confirmation, but compound credit with BHZ and Hasan omitted) is a close second and P002 (cleanest attribution, but a precision gain within the metrology line honoured in 2005 and 2012) third. A prize this year is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No specific tie to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer, Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye is apparent from my profile; my documented PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGO and XL-Calibur connections are in astroparticle instrumentation and would matter only for B040 or B008, neither of which is in the slate.
